name: Post-Incident Review & Improvement
description: Conducts structured post-incident reviews to identify root causes, extract lessons learned, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence. Tracks improvement actions from identification through implementation and verification.
threat_addressed: Without post-incident review, organizations repeat the same mistakes. Agents may encounter the same failure modes repeatedly without systemic improvement. Regulatory frameworks require evidence of continuous improvement based on operational experience.
enforcement_mechanism: Generates post-incident review templates from preserved evidence. Tracks root cause analysis, improvement recommendations, and implementation status. Feeds lessons learned back into governance policy, control thresholds, and behavioral baselines.

security_outcome.pass: Post-incident review completed with improvement actions identified and tracked.
security_outcome.fail: Post-incident review not conducted or improvement actions not tracked.

display_detail: Conducts post-incident reviews and tracks improvement actions to prevent recurrence.
remediation_hint_template: Post-incident review pending. Conduct root cause analysis and document improvement actions for recent incident.
